{{Short description|Type of uniform tiling in geometry}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|U65_s}}
In [[geometry]], the '''snub pentahexagonal tiling''' is a [[Uniform tilings in hyperbolic plane|uniform]] tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of sr{6,5}.

== Images ==
Drawn in chiral pairs, with edges missing between black triangles:
:[[File:H2 snub 256a.png|240px]][[File:H2 snub 256b.png|240px]]
